# clutch.primals.eco — Clutch Justice Investigation Platform

> Collaborative investigation platform covering Michigan court accountability,
> charter school fraud, and institutional capture. Every fact sourced to public records.

## What This Site Is

clutch.primals.eco is the collaborative investigation layer for the Clutch Justice
network. It aggregates evidence from multiple investigation nodes (detroit.primals.eco,
barry.primals.eco, tuebor.primals.eco) and presents them as a unified, walkable
investigation graph.

Visitors ("traveling salesmen") navigate the graph, discover connections between
nodes, verify evidence, and help identify patterns across investigations.

## Active Investigations

1. DETROIT (Wayne County): Cash for Kids 2 — 87 nodes, 120+ edges, $4.9M public money
   - Brian Roderick Banks (9 convictions, 6 felony) runs 2 charter schools
   - Judge Cylenthia Miller chairs his school board
   - Lisa Moreland (AAG) serves as vice chair
   - Evidence: detroit.primals.eco (113+ pages)

2. SAGINAW (Saginaw County): Ghost Witness — 13 convergence points
   - Philip L. Ellison ($74K federal sanctions) submitted fabricated witness
   - Court signed contempt against journalist who documented it
   - IC3 complaint filed. COA appeal pending.
   - Evidence: barry.primals.eco

3. BARRY COUNTY: Disappeared Judge — Active JTC investigation
   - Judge Michael Schipper: 6-10x guideline sentencing
   - Prosecutor Julie Nakfoor Pratt: private ADB admonishment, Brady failures
   - Federal involvement confirmed
   - Evidence: barry.primals.eco

4. EASTPOINTE (38th District): Judge Kathleen Galen
   - JTC admonition. Jailed pregnant woman (reversed).
   - Nov 2026 election: Galen vs. Goodman

## Cross-Investigation Connections

The Attorney Grievance Commission (94% dismissal rate), Judicial Tenure Commission,
and SCAO appear as shared nodes across ALL investigations. The same enforcement
failure pattern repeats in every county.
